name: Beaker
description: A cylindrical container used for mixing, heating, and holding liquid samples.

name: Erlenmeyer Flask
description: A conical flask useful for titrations, swirling, and mixing without excessive splashing.

name: Test Tube
description: A small tube used for observing reactions in tiny quantities.

name: Round-bottom Flask
description: A flask designed for heating and distillation due to its rounded bottom.

name: Pipette
description: A precision tool for transferring small, accurate volumes of liquid.

name: Buret
description: A graduated tube used to deliver precise liquid volumes in titration experiments.

name: Volumetric Flask
description: A flask calibrated for preparing solutions at an exact volume.

name: Graduated Cylinder
description: A tall container with volume markings used to measure liquid volume accurately.

name: Glass Rod
description: A stirring rod used to mix liquids or guide solutions without reacting with them.

name: Alcohol Lamp
description: A small heat source commonly used for gentle heating in chemistry labs.

name: Test Tube Rack
description: A rack for holding multiple test tubes upright and safely.
